title: Surge Smoothing: Predictive Overage Escrows & SLA Microtiers for Dedicated GPU Reservations
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Customers buying reserved GPU capacity want predictability for steady-state usage but also predictable, economical behavior during short spikes. Current reserved packages either (a) over-commit and cause sticker shock on overage, or (b) force large commitments that block smaller teams. We need a new packaging concept that smooths revenue volatility while providing enterprise-friendly contract language and SQ (security questionnaire) alignment for private deployments.

Proposal: Experiment with a two-part product: 1) a Predictive Overage Escrow (POE) that pre-buys a small surge buffer pooled across commitments and amortizes it as an "escrow credit" with automated smoothing logic; and 2) SLA Microtiers that allow customers to pick latency and availability bands (e.g., Gold/Silver/Bronze) with transparent pricing differentials and controlled fallback policies. The offering will be surfaced as an add-on to Dedicated. We will run a pilot with 8 enterprise customers and 30 self-serve accounts.

Goals: reduce sticker-shock overage calls, increase conversion of mid-market accounts to reserved plans, and keep revenue more predictable for the business while preserving reasonable unit economics for spikes.
success_metrics: Decrease in immediate overage invoices contested by customers by >= 60% for pilot participants
Conversion lift: +12% of mid-market customers (ARR 50k-500k) move from on-demand to reserved + POE within 90 days
Average overage revenue smoothing: reduce month-to-month overage variance by 30% for pilot accounts
Net revenue retention: pilot cohort NRR >= 105% over 6 months
Customer satisfaction: post-pilot CSAT >= 4.0/5 for pricing clarity
experiment_plan: Phase 0 (2 weeks): Legal & Security alignment to draft contract language and SQ answers (BYOK/KMS, audit logs, data residency). Create POE accounting model and margin guardrails.
Phase 1 (4 weeks): Build billing prototype that tracks escrow usage, burn rate, and automated top-ups. Add UI to Console for POE status and SLA Microtier selection.
Phase 2 (8 weeks pilot): Enroll 8 enterprise customers via Solutions and 30 self-serve customers with a special promo. Run A/B pricing: POE 5% of committed capacity vs 10% vs control (no POE).
Phase 3 (4 weeks): Collect telemetry (latency SLOs, overage events, escrow burn), customer interviews, and legal feedback. Iterate contract language and SQ attachments.
Phase 4 (2 weeks): Decide go/no-go and pricing roll into release or retire prototype. Produce playbook for sales/solutions and updated SQ bundle for managed/private deployments.
contract_language_notes: Define POE as credited capacity hours (or GPU-minutes) that are drawn before charging per-token overage rates.
Escrow replenishment triggers: automated top-up threshold (e.g., 20% remaining) OR manual approval for large refills.
Clear outage fallback: if Gold latency tier cannot be met, automatic temporary downgrade to Silver with SLA credits applied (formula in SOW).
Cap on enterprise liability for misuse or runaway bursts tied to escrow maximum and an emergency throttling clause.
Include termination and migration language specifically for Private deployments (data egress fees, KV cache state transfer guidance).
sq_requirements: Add POE-specific entries to SQ: explanation of how escrow data is billed and logged, proof of immutability for escrow transactions (audit trail).
Confirm BYOK/KMS mapping for escrow billing metadata is stored only in customer KMS for Private customers.
Provide example artifact: POE billing flow diagram (drive link) and sample audit report for escrow events.
Add security control Qs: who can trigger manual top-ups, RBAC requirements for Solutions teams, and alerting for anomalous escrow drains.
stakeholders: Sasha Ivanov (Console Eng) - UI for escrow/SLA settings
dependencies: Console feature flagging and UI slot (DES-41021)
Legal signoff on new SLA microtiers (contract template update)
SQ artifacts: sample audit report generation (Security infra work)
risks_mitigations: Risk: Customers misinterpret escrow as refundable deposit -> Mitigation: explicit contract language and in-Console glossary explaining non-refundable amortization and use-cases.
Risk: Escrow pool is gamed to avoid commit -> Mitigation: cap ratio of POE to committed capacity (max 25% of committed), and unusual pattern detection with manual review flags.
Risk: Billing complexity increases collection friction -> Mitigation: build clear invoice line-items and a sandbox invoice for pilot customers to preview charges.
Risk: SQ friction for regulated customers -> Mitigation: provide a focused SQ addendum that lists artifacts and a single security contact for pilot customers.
rollout_plan: Pilot only: enroll customers with NDA where necessary; run for 90 days with weekly telemetry reviews.
If success thresholds met, release as paid add-on in Console under Dedicated > Add-ons with opt-in and a migration helper flow.
Ship playbook for Sales/Solutions and CSMs including negotiation scripts, typical discount bands, and recommended cohort sizing.
Update SQ package in Drive and link to commercial contracting templates.
acceptance_criteria: Billing prototype accurately reports escrow balance and burn with <= 5% discrepancy across test cases
Console exposes SLA Microtier selection and shows projected monthly spend with POE applied
Legal and Security sign-off on contract & SQ addendum
Pilot cohort onboarded and telemetry shows escrow buffer used in at least 30% of surge events without emergency overage charges
